items.text: Mariners trade Mike Zunino, Guillermo Heredia and Michael Plassmeyer to the Rays for Mallex Smith and Jake Fraley
Frank Thomas becomes a free agent (White Sox)
Padres trade cash, Terrence Long and Dennis Tankersley to the Royals for Ryan Bukvich and Darrell May
Blue Jays trade Shawn Green and Jorge Nunez to the Dodgers for Pedro Borbon and Raul Mondesi
Robin Yount becomes a free agent (Brewers)
Dennis Eckersley becomes a free agent (Cubs)
Rollie Fingers becomes a free agent (Brewers)
Rick Ferrell becomes a free agent (Tigers)
